step1_figure.circuit_type: Comparator pre-amplification stage with positive feedback decision circuit
step1_figure.description: Figure 27.5 shows the complete schematic of the comparator pre-amplifier and decision circuit used in Example 27.1, combining the NMOS differential input pair with diode-connected PMOS loads (Fig. 27.3) and the cross-coupled positive feedback NMOS decision load (Fig. 27.4), biased by the current mirror Iss = 40 uA.

switching_point_high.description: Upper switching point threshold voltage (VSPH = vp - vm) of the comparator with positive feedback hysteresis

equation.explanation: Calculates the positive input differential voltage required to flip the decision circuit when beta_B >= beta_A. When beta_B = beta_A, VSPH = 0 (no hysteresis).
equation.assumptions: M1-M2 in saturation, Iss completely steered to one side at transition, square-law device model.

sky130_expected.calculation: For SKY130 at VDD=1.8V with Iss = 40 uA, input common-mode Vm = 0.9V. Diff-pair ID = 20 uA each. Assuming (W/L)1,2 = 10u/1u, gm = sqrt(2 * un*Cox * (W/L) * ID) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 20u) = 328.6 uA/V. For beta_B/beta_A = 1.2 (W6,7/W5,8 = 1.2), VSPH = (40 uA / 328.6 uA/V) * (0.2 / 2.2) = 121.7 mV * 0.0909 = 11.06 mV. If beta_B = beta_A, VSPH = 0 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the ratio beta_B/beta_A and transconductance gm. In Example 27.1, with beta_B/beta_A = 1.2 and Iss/gm = 40/150, VSPH was 24 mV. In SKY130 with higher gm, VSPH is typically 10 mV to 20 mV.

switching_point_low.description: Lower switching point threshold voltage (VSPL = vp - vm) of the comparator during a downward input sweep

equation.explanation: By symmetry of the differential pair and decision circuit, the lower switching threshold is the exact negative of the upper threshold.
equation.assumptions: Fully symmetric layout and matched devices.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Negative mirror of VSPH around the reference common-mode level vm.

hysteresis_voltage.description: Total input-referred hysteresis window width (Vhyst = VSPH - VSPL)

equation.formula: V_HYST = V_SPH - V_SPL = 2 * (I_SS / g_m) * ((beta_B / beta_A - 1) / (beta_B / beta_A + 1))
equation.explanation: Defines the total noise immunity band of the comparator to prevent chattering at output transitions.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_HYST = 2 * 11.06 mV = 22.1 mV for beta_B/beta_A = 1.2; 0 V for beta_B = beta_A.
sky130_expected.reasoning: In Example 27.1, Vhyst was 48 mV (2 * 24 mV). In SKY130 with higher transconductance, Vhyst is between 20 mV and 40 mV.

output_voltage_high.description: High output voltage (VOH) of decision circuit node vop when current is fully steered to that branch

equation.explanation: When iop >> iom, M5 and M7 are fully on while M6 and M8 are off, causing vop to be set by the gate-source voltage of diode-connected M5 carrying iop.
equation.assumptions: M5 in saturation, iop = Iss = 40 uA.

sky130_expected.reasoning: In SKY130 (VDD=1.8V, Vth=0.42V), the overdrive voltage is ~0.17V to 0.25V, placing VOH between 0.55V and 0.75V.

output_voltage_low.description: Low output voltage (VOL) of decision circuit node vom when the opposite side conducts all current

equation.explanation: When M8 is off and M7 carries the mirrored current pulling vom down towards ground, vom drops to near 0 V.
equation.assumptions: Complete current steering away from M4/M8.

sky130_expected.calculation: With no current injected into M8 and M7 fully conducting, vom is pulled down to near ground, limited by residual leakage and subthreshold conduction.
sky130_expected.reasoning: In real MOS circuits with channel resistance and leakage, VOL typically rests around 50 mV to 150 mV.

tail_current.description: Bias tail current Iss provided to the NMOS differential input pair

equation.explanation: Tail current set by bias generator SUB_1 feeding Vbiasn to current source transistor xmsu3.

sky130_expected.calculation: Nominal design target from Baker Fig. 27.5 is Iss = 40 uA. With PDK variations in SUB_1 beta multiplier, Iss settles near 40 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The self-biased current reference SUB_1 (Fig. 20.15) with R1=6.5k establishes ~40 uA tail current.

quiescent_power.description: Total DC power dissipation of the comparator circuit including the bias generator

equation.explanation: Total static power drawn from the 1.8V supply rail by both the core comparator branches and the bias network.
equation.assumptions: Vp = Vm = 0.9 V DC common-mode operating point.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current includes: pre-amp diff pair (Iss = 40 uA), decision circuit branches (2 * Iss = 80 uA), and bias circuit SUB_1 (~80 uA). Total current ~ 200 uA. P_diss = 1.8 V * 200 uA = 360 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Total supply current is dominated by the mirrors and bias circuit branches, summing to approximately 150-300 uA at 1.8V.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive ngspice testbench for Baker Fig. 27.5 pre-amp and decision circuit comparator. Performs DC sweeps (both upward and downward) to extract VSPH, VSPL, VHYST, VOH, and VOL, followed by an operating point analysis to measure tail current Iss and quiescent power dissipation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Baker Fig 27.5 Preamp and Decision Circuit Comparator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameter definitions for SKY130 (W/L based on Baker Fig 27.5 & Ex 27.1)
.param W_xmsu3=20u L_xmsu3=2u
.param W_xm1=10u   L_xm1=2u
.param W_xm2=10u   L_xm2=2u
.param W_xm31=30u  L_xm31=2u
.param W_xm41=30u  L_xm41=2u
.param W_xm3=30u   L_xm3=2u
.param W_xm4=30u   L_xm4=2u
.param W_xm5=10u   L_xm5=1u
.param W_xm6=12u   L_xm6=1u
.param W_xm7=12u   L_xm7=1u
.param W_xm8=10u   L_xm8=1u

* Parameters for SUB_1 bias circuit
.param W_xmsu1=10u L_xmsu1=2u
.param W_xmsu2=10u L_xmsu2=2u

* Power Supplies and Inputs
VDD VDD 0 1.8
Vp vp 0 0.9
Vm vm 0 0.9

* Pre-amp Tail Current Source
xmsu3 N003 Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu3} l={L_xmsu3}

* Pre-amp Diode-Connected PMOS Loads
xm31 N002 N002 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm31} l={L_xm31}
xm41 N001 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm41} l={L_xm41}

* Pre-amp Differential Pair NMOS
xm1 N002 vp N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 N001 vm N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}

* Current Mirror Drivers to Decision Circuit
xm3 vop N002 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm4 vom N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}

* Positive Feedback Decision Circuit (M5, M6, M7, M8)
xm5 vop vop 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm6 vop vom 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xm7 vom vop 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm8 vom vom 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}

* Bias Generator Subcircuit (Fig. 20.15)
.subckt SUB_1 Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD GND
  xmsu2 N001 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu2} l={L_xmsu2}
  xmsu1 N001 Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu1} l={L_xmsu1}
  xmsu3 VDD N001 Vbiasn 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu3} l={L_xmsu3}
  xm3 Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm4 Vbiasp Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
  xm1 Vbiasn Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Vbiasp Vbiasn N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
  R1 N002 GND 6.5k
.ends SUB_1

X_U1 Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD 0 SUB_1

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point Analysis
op
let iss_val = @m.xmsu3.msky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8[id]
let p_diss = -i(vdd) * 1.8
print iss_val
print p_diss

* 2. Sweep Vp upwards to find VSPH, VOH, VOL
dc Vp 0.85 0.95 0.1m
let diff_out = v(vop) - v(vom)
meas dc v_oh max v(vop)
meas dc v_ol min v(vom)
meas dc vp_cross_up when diff_out=0 rise=1
let vsph_val = vp_cross_up - 0.9
print vsph_val

* 3. Sweep Vp downwards to find VSPL
dc Vp 0.95 0.85 -0.1m
let diff_out_dn = v(vop) - v(vom)
meas dc vp_cross_dn when diff_out_dn=0 fall=1
let vspl_val = vp_cross_dn - 0.9
let vhyst_val = vsph_val - vspl_val
print vspl_val
print vhyst_val

quit
.endc
.end
